Agent.text:
I built "Tickerra", a five-page charting site with its own name and logo, and its chart is fully interactive. You get candlesticks and other chart styles, timeframes from 1 minute to 1 month, and quick range buttons. There are about a dozen drawing tools with undo, plus moving averages, Bollinger Bands, RSI, MACD and volume. Symbol search, a live-updating watchlist, price alerts and a bar-by-bar replay are also in, all running on made-up market data. I clicked through drawing, indicators, symbol search and switching symbols in a browser with no errors.

It doesn't yet meet the look-alike target. Craft Anything's check rates it 54% alike against the 90% it asks for. The chart page scores 63% and the phone menu 97%; the Ideas and Brokers pages are the furthest off.

Most of the remaining gap is pictures and wording I deliberately didn't copy: the earth photo, real company and broker logos, the community chart screenshots, and the original text and brand names. Those are now drawn shapes, letter badges and sample copy I wrote. Picture generation isn't set up, so I couldn't make realistic replacement images. The big heading font is a close free substitute for the original's paid one.

A good next step would be to add a fal.ai key in Settings → AI so I can make proper hero and preview images. Or you could ask me for something like a dark theme or saving several chart layouts.

Agent.text:
I set the content widths the check asked for, made the text smaller on the Ideas and Brokers pages, tightened the Brokers header and gave the phone chart wider candles. The Markets page now has every heading the check said was missing (Corporate bonds, ETFs and Economy blocks), and its page length is now close to the original's.

The latest check still scores the site 54% alike (home 59%, chart 63%, Markets 57%, Brokers 48%, Ideas 44%, phone menu 97%), far short of the 90% target. Most of the gap is photos, company logos, chart screenshots and wording I replaced on purpose, so further layout work won't close it. I also didn't copy one quirk: the original's Ideas page picture shows its header stuck halfway down the page.
